facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but repatriate within 90 days and convert 50% to meticais.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, if you have proven foreign-currency income such as exports.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register a sole proprietorship at the BAU one-stop shop, typically 7–15 days.
facts.L2_tax_id: NUIT, the tax number from the Tax Authority.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed up to 32%; small taxpayers under MZN 4m can use ISPC.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% VAT; threshold reportedly MZN 2.5 million, needs official confirmation.
facts.L5_data_protection: No general data protection law yet; a bill was submitted in 2026.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within seven working days for off-premises purchases.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; ISPC is limited to 5 years for liberal professions.

watch_out.text: Half of foreign earnings must currently be converted to meticais.
Consultants pay 15% under ISPC and can stay at most 5 years.
